body: Very dirty and smelly bathrooms and showers. You have to pay 50 Rs per person for shower ( which is ok) , but you are not allowed to use shampoo or soap except from water inside the bathroom. Bathroom floor is very disgusting. I will never go back there again.
title: Do not go there

body: We should pay Rs.800 when entering into the casuarina beach and we should pay separate Rs.50 when we entering into the bathing rooms. Changing rooms and wash rooms are very dirty and they do not allow to take shampoo and soap into the bathing rooms. And the bathing time is limited to 2 mins in bathing room. Again I highlight that changing rooms and wash rooms are very bad and smelly is very bad and those changing rooms are disgusting. Actually they don't clean them. Even though we pay money they don't maintain those changing rooms and washrooms properly. So it's a waste of our money. We can't enjoy there peacefully. So, anyone don't go there.
title: Complaining about changing rooms in casuarina beach

body: Casuarina Beach (Karainagar, Jaffna) – Famous for calm, shallow waters and white sand. A peaceful beach in the north.Casuarina Beach is one of the most popular and beautiful beaches in Jaffna, located on Karainagar Island. It is well known for its calm and shallow waters, making it safe for swimming. The beach is lined with Casuarina trees, which provide shade and add to its natural charm. Its soft white sand and peaceful atmosphere make it a favorite spot for both locals and tourists. Unlike many crowded beaches, Casuarina Beach offers a quiet and relaxing environment, ideal for family trips and picnics.
title: Best beach in Jaffan

body: This long beach in Karainagar is 20 km from Jaffna. It is considered the best white sand beach in Jaffna. A number of fishermen catch prawns in bamboo traps with lights at night to attract them. These traps are large and just off the beach. The waters are calm and a number of people swim and picnic here. Not many people on the beach. There are toilet and change facilities. Easy level place to walk, wear thongs, hat and take water. Lots of water birds here because of the prawns
title: Considered best white sand beach in Jaffna

body: We came here with low expectations, but the beach was fantastic!The sea was very calm, shallow and warm and the sand was clean from plastic. I would recommend that you bring your own food and water to this beach, as there is not anywhere to buy there. There are some changing and bathroom facilities, however you do need to pay for those. You also have to pay both people and vehicle entrance as well.
title: Fantastic Beach

body: There was a cover charge of 500 rp per foreigner and 250 for my driver. The facilities were funded by the EU but have been allowed to decline. The beach itself was littered with thousands of plastic bottles and other rubbish. Some care into this site might justify the entry fee.
title: Dissapointed

body: Very nice hotel, location is perfect. Beach clean and very nice.Fiona and Sabrina very professional and helpful. All people working there are very nice.
title: Casuarina a must to visit

body: Over sold, it's okay if you really have too. I was disappointed. Pay 500r as a foreigner to enter area. There are toilet and changing facilities. Actually public toilet was spotlessly clean which is not usually the case. The beach is clean but you can't get away from young men who are obsessed with staring and it becomes uncomfortable. I elected to stay dressed. Sat enjoyed sand and scenery. There are boats coming and going. Family friendly. Lots of sri lankans come in special buses as groups. There is a shop for drinks,snacks and basic food. It's not a must place as far as I'm concerned. I went out of curiosity because the photos on line looked good. Here are the actual during day.
title: Casuarina beach

body: A paid family beach (500 rupees/person) not very interesting. If you're around, why not. The beach is not essential compared to the beaches of the East Coast for example.

body: Mr. Lahiru take us to many beautiful places in Srilanka. We love Sri Lanka because Lahiru show us beautiful places .The best he took is this beach
title: Mr.Lahiru is a good tourist guider in Srilanka

body: Disgusting! The beach is full of rubbish and dog poop... like almost everywhere in Sri Lanka, the crows attack as soon as you try to unpack something edible and then there's an entrance fee! I don't know how this beach got good reviews. If you want more tourists to come, you should at least make sure it's clean.

body: This location was amazing, the beach is pretty clean and have ample parking(Rs 300 parking fee for cars). They are still in the process of improving. They have an issue with fresh water, they charge Rs.50 per head and give max 2 mins, the showers are below par sadly. Also I'd strongly advise against taking the shorter AB17 road from Jaffna as its disastrous, instead opt for the AB21, its longer but most of the road is properly surfaced.

body: Incredible beach, the ice is crazy, the rollers are the same, the waves are almost non-existent, perfect for swimming in peace.

body: Beautiful beach in a paradise island just off the coast of Jaffna. It's connected to the mainland by a single bridge. The beach was calm and quiet. Very picturesque
title: Sunsets

body: Kept quite clean. Lots of new buildings since our last visit. Rooms to shower and change. The waters were clear and clean. Brought back some lovely childhood memories.

body: Beautiful place to go to during the evenings. In a beautiful island called Karainagar just off the peninsula of Jaffna. Palmyra trees and fresh seafood was just the way to spend our time

body: Nice beach located at the top of the country. Perfect venue to spend an evening with some Palmyrah toddy. Entrance to the area closes at 6.30 pm therefore its preferred to plan out the trip and adhere to its operating hours.

body: Without doubt the best beach in jaffna. Really nice and calm beach with lesser waves which makes it easier to have a warm bath in sea water. Perfect spot to enjoy nothern sunset in the island. From jaffna town it is around 26km away and you can rent a taxi to reach there. Perfect spot for beach lovers to spend their day.

body: One of the beautiful beaches in Jaffna peninsula. Clean white sand with small waves makes it child friendly environment.

body: Great beach, very clean, not so crowded. No litter at all. Not too rocky as well. There were great parking facilities available for the public.

body: Well kept beach, clean, no unwanted hangars on, easy to access, and safe vehicle park. Good place for a sea bath or beach sports.

body: This is a cool beach you can enjoy the sun. love the location less crowed and you can buy food at beach restaurants. all facilities are there

body: Sun sea and sand - this is the typical Northern beach which is a lovely place to visit if you are ever in Jaffna.

body: calm and peaceful.early morning trip advisable.changing rooms crude,to be upgraded.more showers and clean toilets need of the hour.sun decks and beach chairs appreciated.more eateries with authentic JAFFNA FOOD a must.care towards sanitation and cleanliness.a fish sales outlet to be provided.more boats for rides.facilities to be developed, but not to be overdone.better be simple and fine tuned.

body: Seventeen of us touring Jaffna visited the famous Casuarina Beach on 7th July 2019. We paid a parking fee of Rs 100.00. The entrance fee was Rs 20 per person. It was an attractive stretch of white sand. The beach acquired its name from the pine-like casuarina trees planted on the shore. The bright-blue waters were shallow, pleasing, enjoyable and warm. People 75 metres in the sea could stand quite comfortably with head up. The area for bathing is marked out by flags. There is a "Surf Point" manned by lifeguards. The Changing facilities are basic. Simple enclosures one each for Male and female. The scotting toilet facilities available are unclean. You can have a shower at a cost of Rs 40 each. Few shops about 75 metres from the beach provide for visitors' needs. There was a van selling ice cream. There was quite a crowd enjoying a swim in the evening in warm waters demonstrating that it is a popular spot.
title: Popular Beach - Calm Waters - Clean and White!

body: Just stopped by for a short while. Din't have time to explore the entire area, but the area we stopped at was quite clean and nice. But there were a few aggressive dogs who leapt at us when we got close to the boats. I saw some reviewers say that the place was dirty ... not sure which stretch but the area we stopped at was ok.Didn't bring swim wear, hence couldn't swim. However I walked a short distance in the water and it was lovely. Coming back to the vehicle walking on the red hot sand was torture as it was noon. Pleasant experience!!Go if you have time and wear footwear to avoid getting your soles burned when you walk on the sand.
title: Lovely Place

body: Very dirty beach as well as the entire Jafna area. Minimum tourist service, few restaurants and accommodation facilities.

body: This is a very good beach here.Not crowded. The sea was rough today due to the prevailing weather conditions.

body: This is the beach at the top of Sri Lanka, about twenty miles from India. There are facilities to change and shower (they cost a small amount). The beach was filled with a large crowd, but the water is shallow enough that you can be out over 100 yards and still be in water. That does not go above your head. It was a welcoming, comfortable vibe, with friendly kids and adults, and a lovely warm water that was salty enough to float in without sinking.

body: Water was nice and warm at around 3 pm. A beach where we can go in and swim. A safe beach to swim in.

body: A must visit destination as the sun beautiful sets over the Casuarina beach . The furthers point in in Sri Lanka with a beautiful beach strip . You will find local vendors selling ice creams and local tourists having a great time . Try visiting if you are ever in the area

body: Nice beach 🏝 totally worth going. They will charge small amount at the entrance but fully worth visiting.

body: Nice peaceful place to have a dip. Shallow and safe water with good changing facilities. There were boat trip facilities from the beach.

body: Stopped a while on a quick tour of the peninsula. Looks a pleasant beach with calm shallow water and not much coral. There were people swimming when we arrived. Some tables for picnics and a small kiosk for drinks and ice-creams. A well made road leads to the beach .
title: Nice beach

body: Casuarina Beach is a nice beach near Jaffna that is accessible with public transportation. You can catch several local bus lines to go to Karainagar (including bus nr. 782 which we took). The ticket is 50 LKR per person and the ride takes around 1 hour. If you tell the conductor that you wanna go to Casuarina beach he will tell you when you should get out of the bus and from there it is a 15 minutes (slow) walk to the beach. It costs 20 LKR entrance fee. There are toilets, changing „rooms“ (more like walls) anf shops for drinks and snacks. The beach is a nice sight but be aware that you are only allowed in the water directly at the beach. We tried to find a spot a bit further away but a beach guard sent us out of the water and back to the beach immediately. Unfortunately our overall experience was not positive. When we arrived we were the only girls. The beach was crowded with young local men and boys and soon „annoy the white girls“ was their favourite hobby. They followed us around staring exessively, they always sat unneccessarily close to us, threw stuff in our direction and took pics with their smartphones even after we told them they shouldn't. In the time we spent travelling through Sri Lanka we never felt this uncomfortable. When we were about to give up and leave, a bus full of nice older locals came and the atmosphere changed to the better but since we already changed out of our swim clothes and the bus seemed to take only a short break we decided to leave anyways. Oh and there is a lot of trash everywhere.
title: we've seen better beaches with nicer people

body: Nice place for a sea bath.Away from the Jaffna city.Beach was clean & had a place for a bath with normal water.
title: Best After 4 pm.

body: It's a nice place well kept and maintained good to have a nice bath and enjoy the evening. The lead up road is also well kept and maintained
title: Nice place

body: Tourists to the Jaffna areas should not miss a visit to this beach. Some areas are closed off to Public, but the main beach is open for swimming. Warm tropical waters, warm sand and tranquility
title: Peaceful warm water

body: Lovely calm water, child friendly swimming beach. Note that there is an entry fee and that the beach is divided into 'Local' and 'Tourist' sections. The tourist section is unfortunately located within the confines of a resort and only available to in-house guests.This place attracts plenty of locals and schoolkids during the school holidays. Best to visit in the morning or after 3 pm when the sand is not quite so hot.There is a shop selling snacks and cold drinks as well as shower and toilet facilities.
title: Lovely Swimming Beach.

body: I have two young boys and as a family we all love the waters. This place was very safe with placid and clean water. There were speed boat rides and changing area separately for men and women. Toilets weren't well maintained. The place is also very neat as people don't litter. I recommend you to carry your own snacks and water.

body: The casurina beach was recommended by an old friend , so decided to make a trek , felt it was well worth the trip , awesome beach , need to have more option for showers and changing rooms

body: Personally, this was my favourite part of my holiday. Lovely white sand beach with blue/green sea. Had a quick 15 minute boat ride to another beach and back (you have option to stay at the other beach or go straight back). Beach has a cafe and shops, highly recommend visiting here!
title: Lovely beach, highly recommend

body: best beach. many tourist visit this place. the beach is awesome. best place to enjoy n relax. not far from the town.
title: the casuarina beach

body: I guess Casuarina is the best beach in Jaffna. That being said. Don't expect much. The water is nice and shallow. You will find a store selling food and snacks, changing facilities, toilets and a boat rental. It's a quiet place. And the kind that you can find thousands of in Asia. Not really worth the trip unless you are already in Jaffna. If you are in Jaffna. Go to the bus station get the bus to Karainagar (40 rupees). Get of at the main road near Casuarina and get a tuk tuk to the beach (150 rupees). There is a 20 rupees entrance fee. Going by public transport is a lot cheaper than hiring a tuk tuk from Jaffna and it's hassle free.
title: Quiet Beach

body: Casuarina beach is one spot where you get winds that may blow you away, a very calm and peaceful place but approach road near the beach is not laid properly. Beach front is also not so clean
title: Enjoy the breeze

body: It's one of those beaches where the whole family can come and enjoy the beach in calm waters and very nice clean white beach. Opportunity to go on a boat trip to see coral and fishes, birds and the shore.

body: Stunning beach, really clean and the water is very clear. About 45mins tuk tuk ride from central Jaffna. Tuk tuk cost 2000LKR return including waiting time at the beach. Good spot to catch sunset. In the early evening many local families come to baths with their children. Women must wear shorts and t shirt to go in the water, changing room are on the beach, plus one or two stalls selling drinks and fruit.
title: Really lovely

body: We went on an eve, there were many people having a bath. It is not a bikini type of a beach so we stayed away from sea. But when you compare with other beaches in Jaffna, this is far better.

body: Not the best beach but it's still a nice and clean beach for families and kids. Wonderful view and water wasn't cold either.
title: Nice beach

body: One of the most beautiful beaches in Sri Lanka definitely a place to visit. The view is amazing and the water is calm
title: A beach you definitely should visit

body: Recommend to visit in the evening due to the climate. We visited the beach around 4.30 pm still the water was hot. Cannot be compared with the finest beaches such as in Pasikuda however a nicer beach in Jaffna. The name of the beach is based on the scientific name of the trees there as it was explained to us
title: Beautiful beach in Jaffna

body: A really nice beach close to Jaffna, popular with Jaffna region residents but not too crowded. The water was warm (february), the beach was clean and life-guarded and there is some shade available for those like me whose skin is too white for the northern Sri Lankan sun :)Most women bathe fully clothed so you might want to do the same.The beach is accesible from Jaffna with public transport (Karainagar bus). The bus stops at a junction with a few shops and a tuktuk can remaining couple kilometres (walkable but mind the heat). There is a small fee to pay at the gate.
title: Nice beach

body: Went here on our day trip of half a dozen tourist sights via tuk tuk. It cost 70 Rupees all together entry. Lots of shade, a few food and cold drink stalls. Water was amazing - very refreshing. It was clean and wasn't too crowded (about 20 people) and it's quite a long stretch of beach too. Has safety flags to swim between and a lifeguard 😀

body: Very clean and nice stretch of beach, very warm water and shallow sea beach is more than 300 meters into the sea. Navy life guards make the place safe and lovely sunset can be witnessed. one of the maintained beaches i should say.

body: Be prepared for very basic changing facilities. Navy lifeguards on duty makes it a safe place. Take care if swimming close to corals - they are sharp and can cut you easily. Superb bathing spot. Take your own drinking water and snacks.

body: It was ok....the water was warm...lots of locals but i wont be rushing back....the breaches at Nilavali and Trinco are far superior.

body: We were told this one is one of the best in Jaffna. We went there by scooter, a cool thing to do also. The beach is nearly clean and there were some shops. It was more like a western beach, a bit more touristic. But definitely worth a visit
title: One of Jafnas top beaches

body: The beach costs about 60Rs (for two people and a scooter) and in contrast to the Chaty Beach it was quite clean. We even found a place in the shade. The water was clear and really warm.
title: Surprisingly clean

body: My mother's friend took us to there. amazing. wow factor is there in the environment. i was rush. nexxt time i would like to spend the whole day. and i have no idea whether public transport is available.
title: god lovely beach

body: Casuarina is one of the top attraction in Jaffna. We were little disappointed because we expected more. The beach is very small and there is not that much to see or do. Boat rides available. No eating place near by. No toilets. Trash here and there in the sand. Not crowded.

body: Good place to go if you need the beach. Sand is very fine and soft, but there is lots of trash on the beach.

body: It's just a simple beach lined with casuarina trees, nothing much to write about if you have already seen too many beaches in your life and strangely this place also has a tiny entry fee ( a first for me). Give it a miss unless you have too much time on hand, like we did.

body: Simply put, there are so many better beaches in the country, don't go to Jaffa for the beach..there lots of other interesting places to visit in Jaffna.
title: Its ok..ish

body: The beach has yellow grey sand and quite clean. There are some kiosks selling snacks but no restaurant. There are also some huts with some tables and benches and a well for washing up and toilet facilities. Quite popular with locals. The nearby kovil is an interesting place to visit.
title: An ok beach for an afternoon

body: It could be a wonderful beach, if more people would care about their surrounding and what they leave behind.And as a woman I won't go there alone and also I recommend not to wear a bikini. It's really not the place.
title: Do something! Too much trash around.

body: Lovely and safe beach, lovely in the morning, there are fresh water available for rinse of the sea water. Few meters away for the entrance, there is a palm toddy tavern you can buy toddy form there, I have met so generous and lovely people.
title: Lovely beach

body: Yes the sand is grey and the beach area itself is not pristine clean with a small amount of rubbish but the water looks very clean. Relatively calm waters to swim in.Yes you have to pay but gee it's only 20 rupees per person and 50 rupees per carThere are places to sit in the shade to picnic, buy food and drink and changeroom/showers.About an hour from Jaffna by car.Watch out for for the jellyfish.
title: It's not perfect but it's still a nice beach area to visit

body: its about one hour travel from jaffna town by bus then we should take tuktuk. its quite silent beach some days are crowded beach side is not clean because of there are no proper maintenance... nice sunny shallow beach in north part of srilanka.
title: one of nice shallow beach in srilanka

body: Went there early in the morning around 7 am while we were heading back home from Jaffna. There wasn't anyone except the janitor.Calm and beautiful beach.Wanted to have a bath but there was no normal water available in the showers.
title: Peaceful in the early morning!!

body: This is a very beautiful beach in Jaffna. You have to pay for the entrance. Best time in the day to visit is early in the morning or in the evening. The sea is not rough
title: Visit to most beautiful beach in northern Sri Lanka

body: Disappointed not the white sands I was expecting. Very small beach as well. There was a sort of change area.
title: Disappointed

body: Had a wonderful bath after Worshiping Nagadeepa VIharaya. Not so deep and no danger. Even suitable for kids.
title: Exellant

body: If you have extra time and really want to swim in the sea. But the beach is quite far from jaffna city center (about one hour drive by bus or tuktuk). Entrance fee is 20 lkr and you have some snack and fruit stands available there. Beach is full of crows and could be a little more clean but it is sill acceptable. Water is warm and be careful about the jellyfish. You can walk 50 meters and the water will still be below your lower part. Of you are a lady, I would suggest not to wear only bikinis since I did not any women bathing with shoulders uncovered.
title: Ok for a dip but nothing impressive

body: Popular with Sri Lankan families and safe for kids because it is so shallow. But the sand is badly littered. Not pleasant. There is an infinitely nicer, cleaner and quieter beach east of Point Pedro (bus from Jaffna bus station, then tuk-tuk)
title: Heavily littered

body: Good place to visit,i feel the water is little bit different than other beaches.Romance in the evening.
title: Nice Beach in Jaffna

body: Our party enjoyed their swim, but one member was quite ill after being scratched by a Jelly Fish. There are signs around but not very clear. We saw the signs just as we were leaving.
title: Nice beach, but beware the Jelly Fish

body: We went to Casuarina Beach in the afternoon. It was not so crowded and nice beach by its view. However, we could not stay there for long as it was too sunny and burning. It is not a good place to enjoy during the day time due to hot sun. Jaffna being in the extreme dry zone of Sri Lanka, afternoon is not good time to visit Casuarina Beach. Late evenings may have been a good though. Note: This is one of the few ticketed attractions in Jaffna.
title: Too Sunny and Burning

body: We went to the beach while we were staying at the Fort Hammenhiel which is about 8km away. We got there early morning at about 6am in time to catch the sunrise. We had the beach all to ourselves. It's clean and the water is shallow for a long distance. There are changing rooms however the taps weren't working. Would recommend to visit early morning to avoid a crowd.
title: Lovely clear waters

body: this beach is very nice and clear sand for swim. life guard stay in this beach. lot of casurina trees be around the beach.
title: Nice beach

body: In July we found this beautiful beach for a break from the heat of sight seeing, with an afternoon swim. The sea was calm. There is a gentle slope to the beach, with no sharp drop away as there is on many beaches in the south west of the island. There is a small charge to enter the beach area. There is good car parking, tidy and reasonably new change rooms, somewhat older toilet blocks, and a beach almost completely clear of rubbish. There were several family groups in the water, and a very relaxed and happy feel to the whole area. A very nice beach!
title: Very Nice Beach

body: was there in June but its not a good season to be there.there is a small charges ti get into the beach side.i think we could hired a boat to go around the beach.
title: fun time

body: You can actually be walking towards the sea without being drowned for atleast 50m the beach is very shallow and easily gets crowded. The best beach to spend your day but they have no facilities to wash yourself after a swim so go home in your stinky clothes. But plenty of fun so don't miss going here
title: Best Beach in the North

body: We had a beautiful day on the beach it was quite there was only one family there when we arrived then the left and we had the place to our selves. We have been traveling for 4 months and 3 of that has been in India and unfortunately on the east of India the beaches are not that good very dirty! So here was a breath of fresh air. White sand, blue water and blue skys. We had a driver take us so we had to pay 20rupees per adult and 40 rupees to park which we didn't mind, iv never had to pay to use a beach before but I was happy to as that part of the beach had a small refreshment shop, toilets and a changing area. I'm not sure if it's like that all down the beach or if you can get to the beach without having to go through the pay point, but like I said we weren't to bothered as it's the first time for a while as a backpacker we have been charged local prices not 'tourist' prices which sometimes tend to be a bit high. So I rate this beach pretty hight it's beautiful and with the exception of a few little bits of liter (which we picked up) it's so clean.
title: Just what we were looking for.

body: The best beach in jaffna. Need a vehicle to access the place. Beach is not that deep , so we can go a little further
title: The beach in jaffna

body: The best beach we saw in Jaffna. Probably a must if you are looking to go somewhere for a swim. Clean warm water and very safe for young children.Down side...very hot sand.
title: nice beach

body: the water is clean and warm - maybe too warm to be refreshing. overall nice beach and suitable for family
title: warm

body: I have been to many beaches in Sri Lanka. Its better than Pasikudah, Marble Beach or any of the down south beaches. The water is Calm and the beach is clean. Simply beautiful.
title: Best beach in Sri Lanka

body: It's one of the cleanliest beaches.. So beautiful and kids can have so much fun. Only disadvantage is that after a sea bathe you will not be able to get a proper bathe. One of the must visited site in Jaffna
title: Cleanliness at its best

body: Best to visit this beach before 8 am. It gets hot after that... avoid weekends and evening visits! We were the only family at 6.30 am, took a boat into the middle of the ocean to look at coral, and all 4 of us- 2 kids under the age of 10 jumped into the sea... amazing experience. totally recommend this place.
title: Great place.

body: Nice place where you can relax at the beach. However it gets bit crowded but it's worth the visit. The road is under construction during my visit.
title: Very popular beach in Jaffna

body: We went on Saturday afternoon, some locals and tourists here, but not too many, relatively clean beach and water, easy to find once you know where it is:) good to go by rented motorbike and make it a long daytrip around the islands...and few stops...better beach and nicer sand is Chatty beach..but smaller.
title: Good if you need a beach near Jaffna

body: Beach is clean and neat but not up to the standard of Thailand's Pattaya or Caribbean Islands. Safe place to have a bath for kids and even adults who dont know swimming. Unlike the Point Pedro's beach, tides and depth is very low. Need to do a lot regarding back facilities, such as standard dress changing room, beach benches, more shady huts etc.
title: Jaffna's "swimming pool"

body: I believe this must be the best beach in Jaffna. And relatively less crowded paving the way for a serene bath
title: Superb beach

body: Clean and clear beach for relaxing and swimming.Changing plases also available.Can enjoy with friends and families
title: Good

body: After a long day visiting almost all Jaffna peninsula it was lovelly to get to this beach and to have a swim. Hardly anyone else were there, just the nature, the beach, the sea and some birds and local people. Very nice!
title: Ah,..the beach and the sea!

body: A location that should be showcased to the world as a must visit. Highly understated, no proper facilities organized. Should be highlighted as a must visit to the tourists.
title: Hidden treasures of this island

body: The Beach is a very famous place among the locals and visitors. Its very special for its white sand and big area...
title: Beach in North

body: We found this map easily on google maps and was about a 30 minute drive from the city.The beach is beautiful and seems to be frequently visited by locals. It was a bit dirty but that could be due to the lack of tourism development in the area. No restaurants and pubs this but just a little shop or two to get a few bites and something to drink. Overall worth a visit at this time as it is still a hidden the treasure.
title: Untouched and beautiful

body: The water was lovely, but the beach full of rubbish. Everything was closed the day we visited, so cannot review the cafes,etc, which are usually available here.
title: Lovely water but beach full of rubbish

body: Very dirty, local Beach, fisherman on one Ende of the beach, beauftiful water. There is no entry fee! You can go there by bus which drops you off on a junction 3 km away. Nice walk to the beach if its not too hot. You have to ask for directions or use google maps.Have seen better beaches in Sri Lanka.
title: Very dirty, water looks beautiful though

body: I will say that we visited in the rainy season, so we saw it at its worst. The beach was littered and dirty with brown grainy sand. Hopefully in the dry months, it is better maintained, and thus would be a nice place to visit, but i wouldn't go again in Dec/Jan.
title: Long drive to nothing special

body: Casuarina Beach is an open narrow sandy beach.... quite crowded with mainly local tourists. Beautiful views of the water and adjacent islands. Little shade . Fell below our expectations ....
title: Open beach for picnic and swimming

body: Casuarina beach is one of the best beaches in Sri Lanka. It's a great place to relax and have a swim in the evening and the water is about 25°C, which is the optimum temperature to have a relaxing bath, according to my opinion. This beach is unknown to most of the tourists who come to Sri Lanka. The sea is quite shallow and you can wade offshore for about 150 metres, when it's about 5 feet deep. The sea seems to be calm, something you won't find in most of the other beaches in Sri Lanka. One of the huge problems in this beach is the lack of an allocated place to keep your valuables while you bath. In the evening, you can see many people there enjoying and most of them don't leave until dusk. You can't visit there after sunset because there is no source of artificial light and also there can be some debris at times, which is not a considerable problem because when you compare it with the other beaches in Sri Lanka , this beach is cleaner and has less pollution. I think a trip to Jaffna is incomplete without visiting the Casuarina Beach.
title: Great place to spend the evening after a day in the hot weather

body: Not really a beach for swimming off, very full of rubbish and debris including an alarming number of little brown vials and bits of syringes. OK for wandering along looking at the stuff washed up and chatting with the fishermen. I would need to be either very brave or very foolish to swim off the beach.
title: Great for beach-combing ........ Not really a swimming place

body: Beach is nice and the sunset on this beach is a wonderful experience. In the downside there are no fresh water showers on the beach which makes it quiet uncomfortable. Sometimes local people set up showers which you have yo pay 50 Rs to have one.
title: Nice Beach

body: I went there on a weekday evening around five. There were not many people. Best sunset I have seen. You have to pay fee of 100 to get inside but more than worth it. You can not find anything to eat. There is a small boat tour.
title: Catch the Sunset from here

body: We were invited to this beach by the owners of our guesthouse and their family. Very local beach atmosphere. Unexpectedly friendly people and great fun. Hot...
title: No foreign tourists on this beach.

body: Casuarina Beach is located in the northern most part of the Jaffna peninsula in an island called Karainagar. This island is connected to the mainland by a long bridge. The beach is mostly calm (at least we when we visited it) unlike the southern beaches of the island. The water remains at waist height for meters on into the sea. There are boat rides available (with life jackets) and the beach has vendors selling ice creams and other tidbits.
title: A beach different from the other beaches of the island

body: By far the warmest water in Sri Lanka I've been in. I walked about 100 meters and water was about up to my chest. Nice scooter ride from Jaffna if you dare scooter in Sri Lanka. Good for relaxing and has a couple stores on the beach for non-alcoholic drinks and water toys.
title: Calm and warm

body: This beach is very different from the other beaches found in Sri Lanka. The sand has a unique color. Shallow water, no waves, can go a long distance toward the sea and a very safe place to have a bath.
title: A beach with a difference

body: The beach has got this name as a lot of Casuarina trees are grown here. Its a good place for people to relax, but nothing extraordinary.Make a visit if you have the time.
title: Nothing Great

body: Went there when the sunlight was fading and less crowd were seen. The place looked messy with lots of people turn up and mess the place...
title: ordinary

body: A nice beach, there is a boat service they can take you snorkelling lots of people on the beach hardly anyone in the water.
title: Casurina

body: Best beach in north part of srilanka. Very smooth sea, 20 minitue drive from Jaffna town. Karainagar is a great island for northern islands
title: Funny

body: Although rated as one of the best beaches in Jaffna area, it is crowded at weekends and the sea is not very clear. Not really worth a detour but if you go do take beach sandals as the sand is VERY hot from 11 am onwards!
title: Crowded at weekends - avoid at peak times!

body: Fabulous sea where you can swim the way you want.Beach is so clean & you can enjoy a lot in the evenings after sun goes down.different kind of fish and sea weeds where you can take beautiful photographs.
title: Beautiful Beach

body: It has an unusual name and my friends from Jaffna educated me that it was given by the Portuguese. On a hot (very hot) balmy day, a dip in the Indian Ocean at the Casuarina Beach was just what the 'doctor' ordered. It was around noon and the sandy beach was on fire. It is a lovely stretch of beach, still unspoilt, with many local families come in for a dip and share their home cooked meals. Hardly any facilities are available but I am sure that the local authorities would address this shortcoming soon and make it a revenue generating project. An entrance fee of LKR 100/- is charged per vehicle.
title: Worth a visit

body: Such a great place to spend the evening. It has fine soft sand and nice smooth waves. The only downside is that, like mentioned, it is pretty overcrowded. If you were looking for a nice quite dip in the beach this won't be the place for it. Also, they really should work to keep the bath room from being such a stink.
title: Great beach, just over crowded.

body: Not so deep until a long distance. less waves. Bit of dirty here and there, seems not maintained and cleaned well. If you walk along the beach you will see some fishing huts towards one end. Go there and have a chat with those people. We learnt a lot about fishing, yes it was fun!! :)
title: Good beach to have fun! Don't forget to talk to the fishermen

body: This the only beach mostly visited by the people living in Jaffna. Nowadays also become an attraction for toursit. Its about 45 minutes drive from Jaffna and lies in karaynagar. Water is shallow and bit muddy since this is not a white sand beach. poorly maintained and not much developed to attract tourist. Samll restaurant available for drinks (non alcoholic) and snacks only. Shower and changing facilities with toilet also available but really poorly maintained.
title: Dirty

body: Difficult to imagine it's the ocean. It's so calm and perfect for safe swimming. It was super hot when we visited but i guess in morning or early evening it must be amazing to just relax in the water.
title: Calm

body: This beach is a disappointment. This place has no waste management; littering on the beach is a common sight.This place doesn't live up to it's hype.
title: Stay away

body: it's really superb beach to visit in Jaffna, I had seen lot tourists enjoying with swimming on this very clear beach
title: superb beach

body: The beach is not good at all and by far not amongst the best beaches in Sri Lanka. The place was packed with bus,van and mass crowds. A lot of litter and no toilet facilities. We wandered off the beaten track and found some much quieter and nicer beaches on Karaitivu
title: Overated and Overcrowded

body: A large, placid beach protected from large waves by a coral reef. Despite a couple of bus loads of tourists arriving whilst we were there, the beach didn't feel too busy. We were staying at Fort Hammenheil which afforded us quick (15 mins by car) and easy access here. There is one shop there which sells snacks and drinks.
title: Beautiful beach

body: The beach is itself is quite unimpressive, and definitely not a place where you would want to spend half a day. It is worth visiting however as a part of larger trip around an island. The area is ambient, and tranquil. Completely non-touristy, very unusual for Sri Lanka. You get to see the local lifestyle, rebuilding of the life after civil war. An interesting experience.
title: Good but only part a larger trip around peninsula

body: Hardly could call it attractive don't waste your time I went on the bus and walked was very disappointed
title: Not worth it unless your driving past

body: Reaching Casuarina beach is a challenge, its about a 45 minute drive away from the city but the drive is scenic. Enjoy the views across the Jaffna lagoon when travelling on the causeway to Karainagar island.The beach opens to the public at 7am, we reached there bang on 7 and had the beach all to ourselves. Probably due to the time of year we were there, the wind was biting cold and the water was quite chilly. The sea is not the pool like calm that you would expect reading some of the reviews, it certainly has waves but the waves are not high and the water is not deep so you can go a fair distance in. My advice is that while this is a very enjoyable beach, its not fabulous enough on its own to warrant such a long drive from the city. Try combining your visit with other attractions in the area such as the Keerimalai hot springs, Dambakolapatuna, or maybe plan to have lunch at the Fort Hammenheil restaurant. But go early to avoid crowds especially on weekends.
title: Shallow shores

body: Casuarina beach is considered as the best beach in the Jaffna peninsula It is about one hours drive from Jaffna. There is an entrance fee for vehicles to enter the beach area.The beach itself very different to normal sri lankan beaches. Instead of coconut trees you get Casurina Trees, hence they call it Casurina Beach. Another difference is the the color of the sand it is also a bit different and it was very soft making it a pleasant experience. The best thing about the casurina beach is the ability to walk towards the sea for miles. The shallowness of the beach combined with no waves makes it an ideal bathing place.
title: Casurina Beach Jaffna

body: This is a highly over rated beach with no one bathing there. It's rather out of the way and a boring place. Far too hot. No shade and nowhere nearby to buy any refreshments or food
title: Boring beach

body: it was so full of people that we didn't spend much time there, it is one of the safest beaches I think as it's not that deep and so calm
title: beautiful calm beach

body: It was in a place called Karainagar where this beach is located.I was born in this village and am very happy to review this beach. As young kids we have been visiting this place where my Grandma used to live from Colombo for every school holidays. The sand was pure white then and now. There were no facilities then but I saw a small Restaurant and some shops at the beach.Water is not so deep so its not so dangerous for bathing. The famous Shiva temple similar to that of Tamilnadu, India's Chithambaram is very close by. If the beach is maintained well it could attract more tourists as it is a very beautiful place.
title: BEAUTIFUL PLACE CLOSE TO MY HOMETOWN

body: Looks like the beaches in Maldives, no waves just clear blue water the sand is white and easy on the feet. there are no such changing rooms. ladies will have to change inside vehicles. parking costs Rs.100 and you get shops around to buy soft drinks and water. try to go early in the morning as there will be less people and the water will not be warm with the heating sun.
title: Beautiful Beach

body: I was not sure if I was missing the point of this place. The beach was peaceful because it was a week day, which was the best part about it. Would like to know if anyone has ventured into the water - it doesn't look welcoming ...
title: A bit of a disappointment

body: It was disappointing to see this beach which is patronized by so many local tourists to be so dirty with so much of debris all over the beach!Long drive to get there is not worth considering so many other beaches to swim in around Jaffna!
title: Dirty!

body: Waves are small and it is a clean. It will take about 45 minutes from Jaffna town. There are change rooms and restrooms.
title: Shallow beach

body: Its a long drive from the city, but the beach is breathtaking and very relaxing. You find few locals around with kids enjoying the warm and relaxing beach. You are required to pay a nominal fee to enter the beach. You can take a boat ride as well, i believe at a cost. This is indeed a very relaxing experience.
title: Breathtaking view!

body: Casuarina is a lovely beach in jaffna. The sea is shallow not rough and you can walk a long distance. Like a swimming pool...nice atmosphere...nice place to relax...Dont feel like coming out of the water..
title: Beautiful beach...!

body: Serendipity ! My one regret is that I did not go prepared to swim. The sea looked like a sheet of glass so calm and wonderful. We took a boat ride that was enjoyed as well. A must see and do on anyone's list.
title: A beautiful Beach

body: We really enjoyed Casurina Beach as the water was lovely and warm and shallow and there were no big strong waves, making it perfect for swimming and ball games. There was a nice family atmosphere and also handy changing facilities. A nice beach to relax for the day.
title: Nice family beach, good for swimming

body: It is a lovely beach in Jaffna peninsula. We had maximum fun on the beach and sea. After sea bath there was fresh water also available to have cold bath thereafter. wash rooms and toilet facilities are excellent. Life guards were also there to help us in case of an emergency.
title: Lovely Casuarina Beach

body: We went to the beach today as part of a tour of the Jaffna peninsula. It is not like the beaches in the south of the country. We found the beach dirty with lots of litter. The sea is shallow but does not look very inviting for swimming.
title: Underwhelmed

body: The sea is shallow and can walk a fair distance. The sea is not rough and you can enjoy like in a swimming pool.
title: Shallow

body: beach area is clean, and very beautifull. There were several restaurant near to beach side. nice place to spent time.
title: blue sky with shallow ocean

body: One of the best beaches in Sri Lanka. Even small children can swim or walk. No waves at all .Avery calm sea- one can walk or swim even to the middle of the sea. A wide beach area with lots of shady Casuarina trees. Very good restaurants with eastern & western food. Also very famous for Crabs & Prawns. You won't feel like getting out of the water & leave the place.
title: Avery beautiful & a nice quiet beach to stay long & bathe.

body: The drive to Casuarina beach was more interesting than the beach itself. The austere, arid landscape, so different to the lush south, filled us with nostalgia and memories of our childhood.The beach itself was Ok, we loved watching local tourists enjoying themselves on the beach. The water was calm and warm. the beach itself was windswpt and dirty in parts.
title: Plenty of people enjoying themselves on the beach.

body: a clean and safe beach located about 15 km from jaffna city center this offers travellers a place to relax and watch the sunset and have a dip in the warm jaffna sea. it is very safe for children and adults who cant swim! as water is shallow over a wide area and with lifeguards on duty. there is fresh water to shower after being in the sea and acceptable places to change in to your swimsuits. enough parking too.the sea however is very very calm with hardly any waves. so not much thrilling. be warned, it can get very crowded on weekends!
title: a place to relax after hard day of travel

body: It was a very clear stretch of beach with hardly any waves. anybody who loves to have a quiet and relaxing sea bath could enjoy this beach. also the long stretch of white sandy beaches are a heavenly experience to walk for miles. All in all its a lovely undisturbed beach
title: Lovely Beach
Breath taking
body: White sandy beach is breathtaking. Every one who visits Jaffna must try and visit this beach. One can walk miles into the sea. Still unspoiled by many visitors. Nice place to have dip in.

title: Worse beach
body: All were telling about this beach and I visited with my family recently. When we entered in to the beach we have been asked to pay 100RS for the vehicle (first time I paid money to enter a beach in my life). Water colour was not clear and we thought due to the crowed but the soil in the sea was terrible, the sand was sooo muddy and it was greasy, lot of sharp stones under the water and its hurts us very badly. The water was smelly and not clean. Immediately we came out from the water and searched a place to take bath. A person was with rental washrooms where you have to pay 100RS for 10mins shower, and the shower water also same as the sea water and finally we end up with skin disease. I would say, careful with sea bath in casuarina beach

title: Clean, too long a drive
body: The beach is clean, though few people drink and misbehave. Police was at hand to ask some to leave. Relatively cleanSad to see such a wonderful place not made the best use of. It can be easily turned in to a wonderful attraction, with a lot local tourism potential

title: Clean and Wonderful Beach
body: This strip of beach, is maintained by the authorities who charge Rs.100/- for the car is pristine and the youth and old folks can enjoy a nice dip in the Indian Ocean. Straight from the point a couple of hundred Kilometers is the Southern Indian shores (my Google Map showed it). It take about 30 minutes to get there from Jaffna Town, but worth the visit.

title: Beach and trees all in one
body: Best public beach in Jaffna lined with Casa trees..clean beach but lot of local crowds..worth making a short stop

title: Shallow waters
body: Casuarina Beach is part of an island - Karainagara about 20Kms off Jaffna town. Karainagar can be reached via road. One can walk a long way in knee/ thigh deep water. The beach is lined by Casuarina Trees which supposedly resemble the Cassowary's trail! There didnt seem to be any changing rooms close by, so prepare to change in your vehicle or travel back in a beach cover up!
